items.description: Cincinnati Spur is the Spur Steak Ranches restaurant at Howard Centre in Pinelands, Cape Town, found at Shop 65 on the corner of Howard and Forest Drive. It is described as a family-friendly restaurant serving steak, ribs and burgers, and the team encourages parents to bring the kids for the well-known Spur menu and dessert. The dining directory that lists the restaurant classes its food as steakhouse and grills, with variety, vegan and vegetarian options also noted. It also takes part in the Crave dining cashback scheme, which lets eligible members earn cashback on meals eaten in, collected or delivered. Pinelands is a garden-city suburb in the Cape Town metro, and the restaurant suits families and groups looking for a relaxed sit-down grill meal.

items.description: VDM Optometrists Kenridge is an optometry practice at The Ridge Office Park on Door de Kraal Road in Kenridge, Durbanville. The practice offers comprehensive eye examinations for adults and seniors using advanced technology, including fundus photography, and assesses the overall health of the eye rather than only updating a prescription. Through its Eyes on Diabetes initiative it uses specialised Oxia reports for the early detection and management of diabetic retinopathy. A dedicated Kids Vision service provides paediatric eye tests that go beyond school screenings, with behavioural eye testing for children who struggle with reading or tire in class. The practice also stocks a wide range of designer frames and sunglasses. It sees patients from across the Western Cape and welcomes the whole family.

Wimpy Howard Centre is a family restaurant at Shop G49 in Howard Shopping Centre on Forest Drive Service Road in Pinelands, Cape Town. The menu is built around all-day breakfasts, burgers, toasted sandwiches and thick milkshakes, along with the Famous Wimpy Grill, hearty lunches and quick coffee-and-light-meal stops. Guests can dine in, collect a takeaway or order online for delivery. The restaurant lists its trading times as 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM from Monday to Friday, 8:30 AM to 4:00 PM on Saturday and 8:30 AM to 3:00 PM on Sunday. The brand also runs a kids menu and children's activities across its family restaurants. It is a practical stop for a weekend brunch or a casual lunch in Pinelands.

items.description: Bearings Distributors is a bearings and seals supplier at Maitland Industrial Park on Voortrekker Road in Maitland, Cape Town. The business serves industrial customers who cannot afford downtime, and describes sourcing as one of its strengths. If a product is not part of its standard stock or readily available in South Africa, the team will source it from anywhere in the world and quote against the customer's required lead time. Breakdown deliveries from overseas are typically 48 to 72 hours, provided the item is off the shelf and not subject to manufacturing time. For local customers, the business states that it offers a 24-hour service, 365 days a year. Maitland is an established industrial area of Cape Town, making it a suitable base for workshops, factories and maintenance teams.

Blackburns Pharmacy is a community pharmacy at 153 Victoria Road in Southfield, Cape Town, and is part of the Alpha Pharmacies group. The pharmacy says it focuses on the patient rather than treating people as customers or numbers in a queue, aiming for patient-centred care that fully meets patient outcomes. It describes itself as small but offering all the pharmaceutical requirements a household needs, delivered with service with a smile. The pharmacy has been trading for more than 50 years and has seen generations of families pass through its doors, and some staff members have more than 20 years of service there. It is well known in the surrounding communities and offers AlphaScript medical aid chronic authorisation approval and follow-up for patients on ongoing medication.

items.description: Essential Health Pharmacy Brackenfell is the Brackenfell branch of Essential Health Pharmacy Group and operates from the Essential Health Building on the corner of Old Paarl Road and Jeanette Street in Springbokpark. The pharmacy trades from 8AM to 8PM on weekdays, 8AM to 7PM on Saturdays and 9AM to 7PM on Sundays and public holidays. A clinic operates from the same branch, open from 8AM to 6PM on weekdays and 8AM to 2PM on Saturdays, and closed on Sundays. Customers can reach the branch by phone or WhatsApp, and the clinic has its own WhatsApp line. The group also lists stores in Clara Anna, Claremont, Gordons Bay, Helderzicht in Somerset West, Kuils River, Strand and Wellington Bergriver.

items.description: Steers Pinelands is a flame-grilled burger restaurant at Shop 11 in Central Square Centre, Pinelands, Cape Town. The branch's own page describes 100% ground beef burgers, hand-cut chips, thick shakes, flame-grilled chicken and Pork Loin ribs, with the King Steer burger as its signature. The restaurant welcomes dine-in guests, takeaway orders and delivery through the Steers app, and lists a brunch counter among its amenities. Trading hours are 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM on Monday, Tuesday and Sunday, 10:00 AM to 10:00 PM on Wednesday and Friday, and 10:00 AM to 9:30 PM on Thursday and Saturday. The Steers brand has served burgers in South Africa since the 1960s. The branch suits a quick family meal or a casual takeaway after shopping in Pinelands.

items.description: Timberland Kuils River is the brand's store at Shop B38 in Access Park, 1 Van Riebeeck Road, Kuils River, Cape Town. Access Park is an outlet-style centre, and the store offers Timberland's rugged footwear and apparel for outdoor adventure and everyday wear at outlet prices. Timberland is known for designing and marketing premium footwear, apparel and accessories for the outdoor lifestyle, and for the original yellow boot introduced in 1973. The store's trading hours are 9:00 to 17:00 from Monday to Friday, 9:00 to 15:00 on Saturday, and 10:00 to 14:00 on Sundays and public holidays. It is a handy stop for shoppers in the Kuils River and Bellville area who want boots, shoes or outdoor clothing without paying full retail prices.

Woolworths Edgemead Village Centre trades from Shops 21 and 22 at Edgemead Village Centre, 50 Louis Thibault Drive, Edgemead, Cape Town. The centre's store directory lists the branch under supermarkets, with operating hours of 09:00 to 19:00, Monday to Sunday. It sits alongside a Spar in Shop 1 and a Tops liquor store in Shop 3, plus the Capitec, ABSA, Standard Bank and First National Bank branches, so everyday banking and grocery shopping can be done in one visit. Other tenants include Clicks, Edgemead Optical, a dentist's rooms, Edgemead Fisheries, Vida e Caffe and M.eat Biltong. The centre as a whole is open from 7AM to 8PM daily, although individual store hours may differ. It serves the residential suburb of Edgemead.

items.description: Checkers Meadowridge is a supermarket in the Park 'n Shop Centre on the corner of Firgrove Way and Howard Drive in Meadowridge, Cape Town. Business directories list the store under supermarket, bakery, deli, coffee shop and grocery delivery service, as well as travel agency, so a shopper can pick up fresh bread, deli items and a coffee on the same visit. A KAUAI outlet operates inside the store, serving healthy and sustainable food made fresh from wholesome ingredients. The store publishes its own specials and leaflets on the Checkers website, which can be browsed by branch. Meadowridge is a residential suburb in the Southern Suburbs of Cape Town, and the store serves households in the surrounding area looking for weekly groceries and quick lunches.

items.description: Essential Dental is a family dental practice at Shop 2, Essential Health Building, on the corner of Old Paarl Road and Jeanette Street in Brackenfell, Cape Town. The practice takes a relationship-based approach to dentistry and is contracted with most leading medical aid schemes, with accounts handled by its administrative team. Services listed include teeth whitening, cosmetic dentistry, dentures, extractions, oral hygiene, orthodontics, restorative dentistry and facial aesthetics such as botox. It is a child-friendly practice that welcomes young children and offers sedation and theatre options to keep them comfortable. The practice is open Monday to Friday from 9:00AM to 5:00PM, and appointments can be booked through its website. It suits families looking for general and cosmetic care under one roof.
